kredi-kart-ba-vuru/state_3/02_outro.png.score_rationale: The screen exhibits significant usability and accessibility flaws, including a lack of visible focus indicators for keyboard navigation and misleading information architecture elements, despite strong overall content organization.
kredi-kart-ba-vuru/state_3/02_outro.png.top_priority_finding: No visible focus indicators are present on interactive elements, which could impair keyboard navigation and accessibility for users who do not use a mouse.

findings.finding: A red numerical badge on the bell icon clearly communicates the presence and quantity of pending notifications.

findings.element: Right-hand persistent bar 'Internet Şubesi Şifresi Almak İstiyorum'
findings.finding: A large, blue, sticky bar on the right side of the screen offers a key action, creating a prominent element that can compete for user attention.

findings.element: Credit card action buttons ('Hemen Başvur', '+ Detaylı Bilgi')
findings.finding: Each credit card product listing consistently provides a primary 'Hemen Başvur' (Apply Now) button and a secondary '+ Detaylı Bilgi' (More Info) button.
The screen lacks visible breadcrumbs or a dedicated 'back' button to assist users in understanding their navigational depth or returning to a previous state.
The primary navigation tabs 'Kendim için' and 'İşim için' are highly visible and effectively segment the main content for two distinct user categories.

findings.element: Top Right Action Group (Search, Notifications, 'Yapi Kredi Ol', 'İnternet Şubesi')
findings.finding: Essential but distinct actions like search, notifications, new customer signup, and existing customer login are visually grouped without strong differentiation in priority, potentially increasing cognitive load.

findings.element: + Detaylı Bilgi' buttons in blue header
findings.finding: Identically styled '+ Detaylı Bilgi' buttons are present in a blue header bar above groups of products, lacking clear labels to indicate what specific information they will reveal.
Each credit card product is presented in a well-defined block, consistently grouping the card image, name, description, and primary/secondary action buttons.

findings.element: Action Buttons within Product Blocks ('Hemen Başvur' vs. '+ Detaylı Bilgi')
findings.finding: Within each product display, the 'Hemen Başvur' button is visually prioritised over the '+ Detaylı Bilgi' button, establishing a clear hierarchy for user actions.

findings.element: Sticky Password Retrieval Panel ('İnternet Şubesi Şifresi Almak İstiyorum')
findings.finding: A floating sticky panel prominently displays the 'İnternet Şubesi Şifresi Almak İstiyorum' function, ensuring constant visibility and quick access for users needing this specific support.
The prominent colors (blue and red) and distinct rectangular shapes clearly differentiate the 'Yapı Kredi Ol' and 'Internet Şubesi' elements as primary interactive buttons.
The descriptive text for each credit card product uses a small font size and light grey color, which reduces its overall readability.
The three credit card product cards are presented with consistent horizontal spacing and uniform vertical alignment, creating a structured and orderly layout.
The '+ Detaylı Bilgi' buttons, with their light blue background and dark blue text, have lower contrast compared to the primary 'Hemen Başvur' buttons, making them visually secondary.
The active navigation item 'İşim için' uses a strong dark blue text color on a white background and a distinct blue underline, ensuring high visibility and clear indication of its selected state.
The right-aligned 'İnternet Şubesi Şifresi Almak İstiyorum' informational panel appears as a fixed-width element, which might present layout challenges on narrower viewports.

findings.element: Main content area with credit card listings
findings.finding: The screen immediately presents multiple distinct credit card products with images, titles, and brief descriptions, requiring initial comparison by the user.

findings.element: Floating 'Internet Şubesi Şifresi Almak İstiyorum' box
findings.finding: A persistent floating box offering to get an 'Internet Branch Password' is visible, which may be irrelevant or confusing for a user who has not yet engaged with a product or become a customer.

findings.element: 'Hemen Başvur' (Apply Now) buttons for each card
findings.finding: Each individual credit card product clearly features a prominent 'Apply Now' call-to-action, indicating the primary path forward for interested users.

findings.element: 'Yapı Kredi Ol' (Become a Yapı Kredi Customer) button
findings.finding: A distinct 'Become a Yapı Kredi Customer' button in the global header offers a clear and broad entry point for new users not specifically interested in a credit card yet.

findings.element: Text link "Internet Şubesi Şifresi Almak İstiyorum"
findings.finding: The blue text "Internet Şubesi Şifresi Almak İstiyorum" against the blue background exhibits a low color contrast ratio, potentially hindering readability for some users.
The notification bell icon appears to be smaller than the recommended 44x44px touch target size, which may increase the likelihood of inaccurate taps on mobile devices.
The search input field, including its placeholder text and magnifying glass icon, appears to have insufficient height to meet the 44x44px touch target recommendation.
The cookie icon in the bottom-left corner is presented without adjacent text, suggesting reliance on an ARIA label for screen reader users, which is not visibly verifiable from the image.
No visible focus indicators are present on interactive elements, which could impair keyboard navigation and accessibility for users who do not use a mouse.
The white text on the dark blue "Hemen Başvur" buttons provides a strong color contrast ratio, supporting good readability.

orchestrator.complexity_reasoning: The screen features a rich header with navigation and actions, multiple detailed product cards, various interactive buttons and links, and persistent floating elements.

kredi-kart-ba-vuru/state_3/01_intro.png.score_rationale: Despite some clear structural and visual positives, the presence of multiple high-severity accessibility issues and several medium-severity usability and information architecture flaws indicates significant problems that will cause users to struggle.
kredi-kart-ba-vuru/state_3/01_intro.png.top_priority_finding: The most critical issue involves the top header utility links, which exhibit both low color contrast, failing WCAG AA requirements, and insufficient touch target sizes, creating significant accessibility barriers.

findings.finding: The main content heading 'Kredi Kartları' uses the identical text label as the active, clickable item in the right sidebar navigation, which could cause slight ambiguity regarding interactivity of the heading.
The red background and distinct icon of the 'İnternet Şubesi' button visually elevate its importance compared to adjacent navigation elements.
The numerical count '3' within the notification badge is relatively small, which could slightly impact its immediate legibility.

findings.element: Main content area and sidebar layout
findings.finding: The wide, two-column desktop layout with a prominent hero image section will require significant re-arrangement for effective display on smaller screens.
A substantial block of introductory text appears before any visual or structured listing of individual credit card products.
The top right utility bar presents a high density of links and action buttons within a confined space.
The 'Kendim için' (For myself) and 'İşem için' (For business) tabs at the top clearly segment the site's content for different user types.
The right sidebar effectively groups related card products and actions with clear navigational labels.
The light grey text of the top header utility links on a white background likely does not meet WCAG AA contrast requirements for normal text.
The interactive areas for the top header utility links appear visually small, potentially falling below the recommended 44x44px touch target size.
The standalone magnifying glass icon, which implies a search action, requires an appropriate ARIA label for screen reader users.
The floating chat bubble icon, likely an interactive element for customer service, requires an ARIA label for screen reader clarity.

orchestrator.complexity_reasoning: The screen features a complex header with multiple navigation items, search, and action buttons, a hero section, detailed content, a multi-level sidebar navigation, and floating interactive elements.

agents_skipped.reason: This screen is a product information page, not typically part of an initial user onboarding journey.
